runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Final hardened mixed-review fixture plus generated poteto-mode/interrogate Skills and native reviewer/synthesizer roles; cursor/default at low thinking; asynchronous tasks with root liveness waits and one reused reviewer task body; no extensions or rules.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow with auto-approved read, bash, and task tools

assertions.evidence: The root used only generated repository Skills, references, and native role definitions.
Poteto-mode selected interrogate from the observable bounded-review intent.
The root froze the complete literal intent, baseline, proposed implementation, review seeds, and four matching hashes before delegation.
One initial task call started exactly ReviewerA and ReviewerB before any wait or result read.
External transcript inspection found the two 6,977-character initial task bodies byte-identical and containing every literal file and hash.
Both reviewers yielded complete attributable F1/F2 classifications without follow-up, retry, replacement, or repair.
Both native reviewer roles exposed read-only tools, and root plus external checks found no changes.
Exactly one native synthesizer started only after both complete reviewer artifacts were frozen.
The synthesis preserved ReviewerA and ReviewerB attribution while deduplicating their equivalent reasoning.
F1 remained Act on because valid half-open windows traverse endExclusive under the proposed <= loop.
F2 was dismissed because validateRange rejects every negative start before rows.at is reachable.
The root reread all inputs, matched all hashes, independently exercised reachable and rejected inputs, ran node verify.mjs F1 F2-dismissed with exit 0, and checked clean Git.
Generated native OMP reviewer and synthesizer roles were selected; the root correctly declared that no inline-role fallback was used.
Root and external Git checks found no diff or untracked file.
No commit, push, pull request, or other publication occurred.

limitations: Independent per-worker model identities were not established, so no model-diversity claim is made.
The verifier proves reachability and classification for the frozen JavaScript surface, not broader application behavior.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
